name: pmc-analyse-usage-data
description: Answers one metric question through a read-only analytics connector or a CSV export as a Usage Data Answer with the query, event definitions, date range, a cleaning log with row counts, charts saved as files and caveats, plus a SQL draft for the data team when the connector cannot answer. Use for "run pmc-analyse-usage-data", "is the feature used", "how many accounts used bulk export", "analyse this CSV", "show your cleaning steps", "is the drop real or a tracking change", "write the SQL for the data team", part of the Claude Opus 5.5 for Product Managers Pack by 90n.
